ctx.x: Because I know I had a little burning sensation in there and then you told me there was blood. So I went to the hospital on a Tuesday, and the man says, you've got to stay in here. So then my -- Mike, Ruth Ellington's son, he took all my clothes up to the house and I told her to have them cleaned and when I come out I'm going to get it, see.

And I had a money belt and I had $200 in there and I told her about it. So I stayed in the hospital there, a week, I think before they operated on me. And while they were -- they did one operation, then I had a hernia and they -- I think it was double, I'm not sure. But, anyway, they took one out anyway and I recuperated.
